question: How can I show different content in my documentation based on user roles?
ground_truth:
You can restrict specific content within your MDX pages to users with certain roles. This allows you to show different content to different user types on the same page. Use the `<If />` component to conditionally render content based on user roles: `<If roles={["beta-users"]}>
  <Callout>
    This callout is only visible to beta users.
  </Callout>
</If>`
